groups.name: Voice & Conversation
groups.summary: Talk to it naturally in any language.

features.name: Speaks your language
features.desc: Understands and replies in Kurdish, Arabic, English, Turkish and more — it switches by itself.
features.example: Try: "Can you speak Kurdish?"

features.name: No commands to memorise
features.desc: Say what you want the way you would say it to a person, and it works the rest out.
features.example: Try: "I'm bored, find me something to watch"

features.name: Type instead of talking
features.desc: Prefer to stay quiet? Type the very same requests into the command box at the bottom.
features.example: Type: "what is my CPU temperature"

features.name: Morning briefing
features.desc: Greets you when it starts with the day's headlines and whatever you asked it to follow.
features.example: Switch MORNING BRIEF on in the Controls panel.

features.name: Speaks up on its own
features.desc: After a long quiet spell it starts a useful, well-timed thought instead of waiting.
features.example: Happens by itself after about 15 minutes of silence.

features.name: Closes when you say bye
features.desc: Say goodbye in any language and it ends the session and shuts itself down politely.
features.example: Try: "that's all for today, goodbye"

groups.name: Computer Control
groups.summary: Runs your computer for you, hands free.

features.name: Opens any app
features.desc: Starts any program or website on your computer just from its name.
features.example: Try: "open Spotify"

features.name: Volume and brightness
features.desc: Turns the sound or the screen brightness up and down, or mutes everything at once.
features.example: Try: "set the volume to 30"

features.name: Windows and tabs
features.desc: Closes, minimises, snaps and swaps windows and browser tabs without you touching the mouse.
features.example: Try: "snap this window to the left"

features.name: Lock, restart, shut down
features.desc: Locks the screen or powers the whole machine down when you ask it to.
features.example: Try: "lock the screen"

features.name: WiFi and dark mode
features.desc: Switches WiFi off and back on, or flips the whole system into dark mode.
features.example: Try: "turn on dark mode"

features.name: Types and clicks for you
features.desc: Types text, presses keyboard shortcuts, clicks and scrolls anywhere on the screen.
features.example: Try: "type my email address here"

features.name: Finds buttons on screen
features.desc: Looks at the screen, spots the button you described and clicks it for you.
features.example: Try: "click the blue Sign In button"

features.name: Changes your wallpaper
features.desc: Sets a new desktop background from a picture on your computer or from a link.
features.example: Try: "set my wallpaper to the sunset photo on my desktop"

groups.name: Files & Documents
groups.summary: Finds, tidies and reads anything you keep.

features.name: Finds any file
features.desc: Tracks down a file by its name or its type anywhere on your computer in seconds.
features.example: Try: "find all my PDF files"

features.name: Creates, moves, deletes
features.desc: Makes folders, renames, copies and moves things, and bins files safely so you can undo it.
features.example: Try: "make a folder called Invoices on my desktop"

features.name: Frees up disk space
features.desc: Shows how full your drives are and names the biggest files eating your space.
features.example: Try: "what are the biggest files in my downloads?"

features.name: Tidies your desktop
features.desc: Sorts a cluttered desktop into neat folders, either by file type or by date.
features.example: Try: "organise my desktop by file type"

features.name: Drop a file, ask anything
features.desc: Drag any file onto the window, then simply ask a question about it out loud.
features.example: Drop a file, then say: "what is this?"

features.name: Reads PDFs and documents
features.desc: Summarises a PDF or Word file, lifts the text out of it, or turns a PDF into Word.
features.example: Try: "summarise this PDF"

features.name: Understands spreadsheets
features.desc: Reads a CSV or Excel file, explains the numbers, and filters or sorts the rows for you.
features.example: Try: "analyse this spreadsheet"

features.name: Works on your pictures
features.desc: Describes a photo, reads the writing inside it, or resizes, shrinks and converts it.
features.example: Try: "read the text in this image"

features.name: Audio and video jobs
features.desc: Writes out what was said in a recording, trims clips, and changes file formats.
features.example: Try: "transcribe this audio file"
features.requires: Trimming and converting video needs ffmpeg installed

groups.name: Web & Search
groups.summary: Looks things up so you never have to guess.

features.name: Answers real questions
features.desc: Searches the live web, so what it tells you is current instead of remembered.
features.example: Try: "search for the best laptops this year"

features.name: Latest news on a topic
features.desc: Brings back today's headlines on whatever subject you care about.
features.example: Try: "what's the latest news about Kurdistan?"

features.name: Prices and comparisons
features.desc: Checks what something costs, or puts two products side by side so you can choose.
features.example: Try: "compare the iPhone 17 and the Galaxy S26 on price"

features.name: Deep research
features.desc: Digs properly into a subject and comes back with a full answer, not a one-liner.
features.example: Try: "do deep research on solar panels for my home"

features.name: Opens sites for you
features.desc: Opens any site or search in your own browser, with your accounts already signed in.
features.example: Try: "open YouTube in Edge"

features.name: Clicks and fills forms
features.desc: Moves through a website for you, clicking buttons and filling in the boxes itself.
features.example: Try: "go to the contact page and fill in the form"

features.name: Weather anywhere
features.desc: Tells you the weather for any city you name, at home or abroad.
features.example: Try: "what's the weather in Hewler?"

features.name: Finds cheap flights
features.desc: Searches flights for your dates and reads the best options out to you.
features.example: Try: "find flights from Erbil to Istanbul on 12 September"

groups.name: Vision
groups.summary: It can look at your screen and through your camera.

features.name: Sees your screen
features.desc: Looks at whatever is on your screen right now and answers questions about it.
features.example: Try: "what is on my screen?"

features.name: Sees through the camera
features.desc: Opens your webcam, looks through it and describes what is in front of you.
features.example: Try: "look at the camera and tell me what you see"

features.name: Closes the camera
features.desc: Shuts the live camera view the moment you ask, in any language.
features.example: Try: "close the camera"

features.name: Takes screenshots
features.desc: Captures the screen and saves the picture where you can find it again.
features.example: Try: "take a screenshot"

groups.name: Media & Entertainment
groups.summary: Videos, music and your games library.

features.name: Plays YouTube videos
features.desc: Finds a video from your description and starts playing it straight away.
features.example: Try: "play Kurdish music on YouTube"

features.name: Summarises long videos
features.desc: Sits through an hour-long video for you and hands back the short version.
features.example: Try: "summarise this YouTube video"

features.name: What everyone is watching
features.desc: Shows the videos trending right now in any country you name.
features.example: Try: "show me trending videos in Iraq"

features.name: Updates your games
features.desc: Installs and updates your Steam and Epic games and tells you how the download is going.
features.example: Try: "update all my Steam games"
features.requires: Steam or Epic Games must be installed

features.name: Downloads games overnight
features.desc: Runs game updates in the small hours and can switch the PC off when they finish.
features.example: Try: "update my games every night at 3am"
features.requires: Steam or Epic Games must be installed

groups.name: Development
groups.summary: Writes, fixes and builds software with you.

features.name: Writes code for you
features.desc: Turns a plain description into a working program and saves it where you want it.
features.example: Try: "write a Python script that renames my photos by date"

features.name: Explains and fixes code
features.desc: Opens a file you already have, tells you what it does and repairs what is broken.
features.example: Try: "explain what this file does"

features.name: Runs it and fixes errors
features.desc: Runs your program, reads the errors that come back and corrects them itself.
features.example: Try: "run this script and fix any errors"

features.name: Builds whole projects
features.desc: Plans a full multi-file project, writes it, installs what it needs and gets it running.
features.example: Try: "build me a to-do list app in Python"

features.name: Reviews your code files
features.desc: Drop in a code file and it will review it, comment it, tidy it or write tests for it.
features.example: Drop a code file, then say: "review this code"

groups.name: Phone & Remote
groups.summary: Use it from your phone, anywhere in the house.

features.name: Control it from your phone
features.desc: Scan one QR code and your phone becomes a remote control for the whole assistant.
features.example: Press REMOTE CONTROL in the Controls panel.

features.name: Talk to it from your phone
features.desc: Speak into your phone and it answers on the computer as if you were sitting there.
features.example: On your phone, say: "what is on my screen?"

features.name: Send files from your phone
features.desc: Send a photo or a document up from your phone and ask about it right away.
features.example: On your phone, send a photo, then ask: "what is this?"

features.name: Private and encrypted
features.desc: The phone link is PIN-locked, encrypted, and stays inside your own home network.
features.example: Press REVOKE DEVICES to unpair every phone at once.

features.name: Sends messages for you
features.desc: Sends a WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Signal, Discord or Messenger message by voice.
features.example: Try: "send a WhatsApp to Dara saying I'll be late"
features.requires: The messaging app must be installed and signed in

groups.name: System & Monitoring
groups.summary: Keeps an eye on your machine and your reminders.

features.name: Live health of your PC
features.desc: Reports processor, memory, GPU, temperature, uptime and how much is running.
features.example: Try: "how is my computer doing?"

features.name: Always-on meters
features.desc: The bars down the left edge show CPU, memory, network, GPU and heat at a glance.
features.example: Always on screen — nothing to ask for.

features.name: Warns you before trouble
features.desc: Speaks up by itself when the machine runs too hot or memory gets dangerously low.
features.example: Happens by itself — nothing to switch on.

features.name: Reminds you on time
features.desc: Sets a reminder that pops up and speaks at exactly the day and time you named.
features.example: Try: "remind me tomorrow at 9am to call the bank"

features.name: Follows topics for you
features.desc: Watches a subject quietly in the background and tells you when something new happens.
features.example: Try: "monitor news about electric cars"

groups.name: Memory & Personal
groups.summary: It learns who you are and stays yours.

features.name: Remembers you
features.desc: Quietly holds on to your name, city, work, tastes and plans so you never repeat yourself.
features.example: Try: "my favourite food is dolma"

features.name: Carries on from last time
features.desc: Keeps the thread of your last conversation, so today starts where yesterday stopped.
features.example: Try: "what do you remember about me?"

features.name: Everything stays on your PC
features.desc: What it remembers about you is kept in a file on your own computer, not in the cloud.
features.example: Try: "what do you know about my family?"

features.name: Give it your own name
features.desc: Rename the assistant and tell it what to call you, so it greets you the way you like.
features.example: Press CUSTOMISE ASSISTANT in the Controls panel.

features.name: One-click desktop launch
features.desc: Puts a shortcut on your desktop so the assistant starts with a single double-click.
features.example: Press CREATE DESKTOP SHORTCUT in the Controls panel.
